sanskrit_verse:
कुलश्रेणिगणादीनां यथाकालं प्रदर्शितम् ।
श्रावयेत् स्मारयेच्चैव तथा स्याद् बलवत्तरम् ॥
transliteration: kulaśreṇigaṇādīnāṃ yathākālaṃ pradarśitam | śrāvayet smārayec caiva tathā syād balavattaram ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is revealed in its proper time among lineage, category, assembly, or collective must be declared, reminded, and established accordingly—thus it becomes authoritative.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from timely revelation within structured collectives
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by access to revelatory context
Restoration occurs through re-establishment of rightful declaration
Consciousness alignment depends on recognition of temporal and structural dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF a declaration was made within a recognized lineage, category, or assembly at its appropriate time, THEN that declaration holds greater authority than later assertions.
IF an individual has access to a previously declared truth within a dharmic structure, THEN they bear the capacity-responsibility to reaffirm or restore it when required.
WHEN conflicting claims arise, PRIORITY shall be given to the claim first manifested within the correct structural and temporal dharmic framework.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication between competing claims, precedence shall be granted not merely by chronology but by the alignment of the initial declaration with the sanctioned hierarchical and temporal structures of dharma. The court must verify both the authenticity of the source and the timeliness of the original proclamation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that authority stems from accurate perception and timely communication within sanctioned dharmic frameworks. There is no punitive consequence for misalignment; rather, correction follows naturally upon realigning with the revealed order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process for any obscured or suppressed declarations within lineages or assemblies
Reaffirm rightful authority through public recitation and conscious remembrance
Facilitate reintegration of individuals who have deviated due to lack of exposure to timely revelations
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. Justice is executed not through punishment, but through the restoration of rightful order and the awakening of inherent consciousness. This law stands immutable, beyond history, beyond judgment — as pure, self-evident Truth.
